commit.message:
xnor: Add C2 xnor AD rules for RISC-V Zbb extension

Add xnor AD rules (xnorI_reg_reg_b and xnorL_reg_reg_b) to
riscv_b.ad to optimize the pattern ~(a ^ b) into a single xnor
instruction when Zbb extension is available. Verified on real RISC-V
hardware (SG2044, SOPHGO) with:
- 1560 correctness test cases (int + long)
- Official jtreg test suite (~412 tests, 0 failures)
- Performance benchmark: 13-14x speedup vs non-xnor fallback

Signed-off-by: Xiaofei Gong <gongxiaofei24@iscas.ac.cn>
Signed-off-by: YuanSheng <yuansheng@isrc.iscas.ac.cn>
